children: United States Natural Gas Fund reported a $67.8 million net loss for July while month-end NAV rose to $475.98 million and NAV per share was $10.01.
Recorded net loss of $67,829,017 for month ended July 31, 2026, driven by trading and swap losses.
Realized trading loss on commodity futures of $29,847,160 and realized loss on swap contracts of $16,937,630.
Unrealized loss on commodity futures market value of $21,795,936 partially offset by $878 unrealized gain on swaps.
NAV increased from $417,699,524 to $475,982,222 after $161,028,412 additions and $34,916,697 withdrawals.
Net asset value per share at month-end: $10.01 on 47,546,103 shares; total expenses were $472,480.
